prompt: Compute $8{,}649 \div 31$ using long division. Give your answer as a **decimal**.
hint: $31$ goes into $86$ about how many times? Try $2$ or $3$.

hints.title: 🪜 Try a simpler one
hints.text: Warm-up: try $93 \div 31$ first. $31 \times 3 = 93$, so $93 \div 31 = 3$. Carry that intuition forward.
Bring down one digit at a time. After each step, check that your remainder is **less than** $31$.

explanation: Estimate first: $8649 \div 31 \approx 8649 \div 30 \approx 288$. Expect a 3-digit answer near $280$.
$31$ into $86$: $31 \times 2 = 62$, $31 \times 3 = 93$ (too big). So digit = $2$. Subtract: $86 - 62 = 24$. Bring down the $4$ → $244$.
$31$ into $244$: $31 \times 7 = 217$, $31 \times 8 = 248$ (too big). Digit = $7$. Subtract: $244 - 217 = 27$. Bring down the $9$ → $279$.

alternativeExplanations.title: Check by multiplying back
steps: If multiplying back doesn't hit the original dividend, redo the long division.

alternativeExplanations.title: Estimate to spot mistakes
steps: So the true answer should be **close to but a little less than** $300$. $279$ fits.
If you had gotten $2790$ or $28$, the estimate would have flagged the missing place value.
